units: <cite ref="Ketubot 106b:14">Keth. 106ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>במקום ע׳</he>, v. <cite ref="P00985"><he>עֲנִיּוּת</he></cite>. Y. Peah IV, 18ᵃ sq. (ref. to <cite ref="I Chronicles 22:13">I Chr. XXII, 13</cite> <he>בעניי</he>) <he>שאין ע׳ לפני מי וכ׳</he> none can claim to be rich before Him who spoke and the world arose.

<cite ref="Gittin 30b:3">Gitt. 30ᵇ</cite> <he>מאי שנא … לע׳ דלא וכ׳</he> why is it that they made provision for the debtor’s death, and none for the event of his becoming rich? <he>מיתה שכיחא ע׳ וכ׳</he> death is an ordinary occurrence, becoming rich is not; a. fr.
